audit.why: Diff is TRICKY, difficulty 7/10 — accurate: Alistar hard-punishes Sona's lack of hard CC pre-6 via Headbutt(W)->Pulverize(Q) knockup-stun, but her aura kit scales past his single-target lockdown late.

Spikes correctly flag level 2 (W-Q combo online), level 6 (Unbreakable Will lets him dive through peel), first item (engage item + boots close the gap), and late (Sona's 2-item aura/Crescendo scaling flips it).

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4]/[5].side (Level 6, First item) were 'Skill' while content win[4]/win[5] already said 'Alistar', and phases[0-3].side said 'Alistar' while content win[0-3] said 'Skill' — the level chart contradicted itself on 5 of 7 rows between the full and content layers.
audit.why: Alistar has zero hard CC before level 6 and a 12-14s Headbutt/Pulverize cooldown, so he threatens the knockup-stun combo on almost every wave through levels 1-5; Unbreakable Will (120/100/80s) then cleanses Sona's answer at 6 and lets him dive. Both signals agreed he's ahead the whole laning phase — only the row labels disagreed with the win column.
audit.corrected: Set phases[0-5].side and win[0-5] to Alistar consistently (matching win[4]/[5] which already had it right); left phases[6]/win[6] at Sona (already agreed) for the late scaling flip.

edits.before: Level 1 is even because your Q poke and his empty engage range cancel out.
edits.after: Level 1 favours Alistar: a Pulverize knockup punishes your poke; Q has no CC.

edits.before: Level 2 is even: your Power Chord threat matches his first W-Q combo window.
edits.after: Level 2 tips Alistar: W-Q lands a knockup-stun — Power Chord can't punish it.

edits.before: Level 3 stays skill as your sustain-poke trades roughly with his short-cooldown engage.
edits.after: Level 3 stays Alistar's: Headbutt refreshes in 12s at rank 3, threatening the combo most waves.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 remain even while his combo scales but your shielding keeps you safe.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay Alistar's: combo threatens step-ups; Aria shields damage, not the stun.

edits.before: Crescendo online — grouped lanes pay the dance tax; your duo's all-in has a stage.
edits.after: Unbreakable Will (120/100/80s) cleanses your CC — his all-in still survives it.

edits.before: First item: the auras compound and the chords chunk.
edits.after: Engage item and boots close Headbutt's gap on you.

edits.before: - Alistar Headbutt: matchup-defining — The headbutt-pulverize combo starts every play — respect flash range while it is up. It writes your spacing rules. - E Song of Celerity is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Headbutt (W) is down 14s at rank 1, 10s at max — that's your punish window. - Trample (E, 12s at rank 1) stacks for a stun off an auto-reset; the wind-up on his last cast is your tell to back off. - Unbreakable Will (120/100/80s) cleanses your Crescendo — bait it before you commit.

edits.before: Q-chord the pair at aura edge, W the trade-back, walk — invisible margins, compounding ledger.
edits.after: Song of Celerity buys the distance Headbutt needs — burn it to deny his range, not just chase kills.
